basic_profile.bio: I'm an avid gamer and self-proclaimed loot hoarder based in Seattle. When I'm not farming for rare in-game items, I'm working as a software developer for a mid-sized tech company. I have a strong dislike for chaotic and unpredictable environments like the Dark Zone in The Division. My typical online hours are in the evenings after work and on weekends. I'm single and often spend my free time exploring new games or catching up on gaming content creators like Scott the Woz.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in Computer Science, which has fueled my passion for technology and gaming. My expertise in gaming comes from years of playing and researching various games, particularly those with complex loot mechanics. I also stay updated through forums, gaming news sites, and by engaging with gaming communities.
